pattern: SELECT .+\_id, MIN\(.*\) as .+ FROM\s+(matches|any other table)\s+JOIN\s+players\sON\s+(\w+)_id\s+=\s+player_id\s+GROUP BY\s+(\w+)_id
correction: Select the minimum value of the column directly from the table without joining with another table and using GROUP BY.

metadata.description: This rule identifies queries that incorrectly join tables to find minimum values, when the minimum value can be directly selected from a single table.
